notes.text: The precise ending witness for the 530-year comparison and decree remains open. The Yuchasin letter He article supports the calendar attribution but is a separate passage. Heilprin’s Part 1 preserves his proposed reassignment in the ending.

Duran’s exact Azharot passage needs direct collation. The citation is also in Yuchasin. Catalogue evidence identifies Zohar HaRakia as Duran’s Azharot commentary, but the direct text result was unavailable.

Keep the three source era designations and the attribution separate from the historical date. The related Heilprin Part 1 reading agrees in substance and relates other authorities. Yuchasin’s digital transcription uses a variant numeral spelling in the Rav Hai citation.
Heilprin marks the chronological pairing as unlocated. Yuchasin has a distinct Abaye and Rava pairing. Maimonides provides a general period description.

The end of the patriarchate is a separate historical claim. The related Heilprin article repeats the claim. The calendar passages establish attributed calendar changes and do not prove the end of the office.
